answers.1:
mkdir -p /tmp/lab
cat > /tmp/lab/hello.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo "hello script"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/hello.sh
/tmp/lab/hello.sh > /tmp/hello_out.txt
cat /tmp/hello_out.txt

# 따옴표 친 'EOF' 는 $ 같은 문자를 풀지 않고 그대로 파일에 적는다
answers.2:
cat > /tmp/lab/greet.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
echo "Hello, $1!"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/greet.sh
/tmp/lab/greet.sh Etude

# $1 은 첫 번째 인자, $2 는 두 번째 ... 이다
answers.5:
cat > /tmp/lab/exists.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if [ -f "$1" ]; then
  echo found
else
  echo missing
fi
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/exists.sh
/tmp/lab/exists.sh /tmp/lab/data/a.txt
/tmp/lab/exists.sh /tmp/lab/nothing
answers.6:
cat > /tmp/lab/lines.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
for f in /tmp/lab/data/*.txt; do
  echo "$(basename "$f") $(wc -l < "$f")"
done
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/lines.sh
/tmp/lab/lines.sh

# 출력: a.txt 2 / b.txt 1 / c.txt 3
answers.7:
cat > /tmp/lab/users.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
while read line; do
  echo "user: $line"
done < "$1"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/users.sh
/tmp/lab/users.sh /tmp/lab/names.txt
answers.8:
cat > /tmp/lab/gate.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
if [ -f "$1" ]; then
  exit 0
fi
exit 3
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/gate.sh
/tmp/lab/gate.sh /tmp/lab/nothing.dat
echo $? > /tmp/rc.txt
cat /tmp/rc.txt

# 종료 코드 0 은 성공, 그 밖의 숫자는 실패(어떤 이유인지는 만든 사람이 정한다)
answers.10:
cat > /tmp/lab/strict.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
set -e
echo start
false
echo end
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/strict.sh
/tmp/lab/strict.sh
echo $?

# set -e 가 없으면 false 를 지나 end 까지 출력하고 0 으로 끝난다
answers.12:
cat > /tmp/lab/report.sh <<'EOF'
#!/bin/bash
count=$(ls /tmp/lab/data/*.txt | wc -l)
echo "txt files: $count" > /tmp/lab/report.txt
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/lab/report.sh
/tmp/lab/report.sh
cat /tmp/lab/report.txt
